segments.text: My wife shut the bedroom door on our anniversary night
Wore the red sari from our wedding, whispered no excuses tonight
But I've been hiding something, something I couldn't let her see
So I said the only words that kept her far away from me
I'm just tired, John, it's been a long day
It's been a long day
10.40 on the clock, she smiled and then she said okay
But that okay was hiding questions she would carry every day
She switched off the lamp and turned the other way
And I lay beside the woman I have loved for 24 years
Two feet away, listening to a sound I still can hear
Her pretending to be sleeping so I wouldn't see her tears
Nobody tells you it's not one night, it's the first of a hundred like that
I kept one secret in my glove box, another in my office drawer
And every night by 10.15 I was too tired once more
Sat out my nephew's wedding while she danced and looked at my chair
And I couldn't tell her why I wasn't standing there
Then at 2am I'd slip out of our bed and shut the door
Out on the balcony, my phone glowing and she saw
I'm just tired, young Same three words every night
Under the bedroom light I'm just tired, young
But I'm tired of lyin' bout why
Then one Sunday I came home early Heard her on the phone crying to her sister
Neelu Sayin' things I'd never known
Eight months Neelu, he won't touch me Won't even hold my hand, I've dyed my
grays I've lost six kilos and I still don't
understand He's on that balcony at 2am on his phone
And I know who, there's someone else Neelu What else could he be doin' it to?
And I stood there in that hallway watching my little lie grow into something worse than the truth
And the worst was yet to show she scrolled through every message every call and found no name
Just what I typed at 2 a.m. And it wasn't who she blamed back pain only at night
How do I hide it from my wife?
She stood there in the doorway held that phone up to my face said is this her is this the other woman and
She fell in my embrace cuz in my head the truth made me less of a man than the lie
But she already had a plan
Next morning she called her mother
Back in Nashik on the phone Ma said
Your papa's back when at 50 and there's something I never told
What I did for him each night 10 minutes before he'd sleep
That night there was something on my pillow
And I promised she would keep
An amber bottle, VSR, Vedic pain relief oil
15 herbs inside
I laughed, another oil, she said lie down
Turn over then decide
She said it's not your age John
It's what your tablets never reach
Inflammation locked in deep
Where sprays just sit up on the skin
Warm massage works the stiffness loose
So fifteen herbs can settle in
Mahanaraya nirgun dai
Ashwagandha camp ferment
Night won her hands on my back
First time she touched me in a year
Night three I slept straight through
And woke to find her watching me in tears
Week six back on morning walks
Standing tall and Friday was near
That Friday I stayed up, didn't fall asleep at 10
She came out in that red saree, nervous like our first night
Again she whispered tired and I gave the answer
She'd waited eight months for not tonight, John
Not ever again
She switched off the lamp
And this time she turned my way, I'm not tired, John
No more lyin' bout why
To every man two feet from his wife
saying just tired every night she doesn't think you're tired she thinks
it's her tell her why
